text:
tori: Quick note  after merging cust-orchid LoRA into serve/main we saw a small but consistent skew in currency outputs in the onboarding quick-eval. Pinging @ash @mira

ash: Details? numbers?

tori: invoice EM down 0.91 -> 0.83 on int4, fp16 drop smaller (~0.02). Patterns show misplaced spaces around commas and decimals.

mira: Can you paste the eval command so I can repro?

tori: `./eval_pack/run.sh --model models/cust-orchid-lora:merge-2026-02-14 --quant int4 --evals packs/invoice_quick.json`

jamie: Saw similar token boundary drift with another adapter. Often tied to tokenizer merge maps + kv-cache offsets after adapter graft.

eva: I kicked off a staging run and caught this in logs: `kvcache: warn - key_offset mismatch (expected 64, got 56)` right before eval start.

ash: If kvcache offsets changed, that can shift attention alignment and produce token insertions around punctuation.

mira: Hold canary. I'll try adapter-tokenizer remap (adapter-swap) and run minimal edge cases for currency grouping.

tori: Added a tiny pack `packs/invoice_edgecases.json` with explicit `$`, `,`, and `.` placements. Re-running now.

jamie: If patch doesn't land quick, fallback route customer to stable base model. Safer than risking malformed invoices.

mira: Agreed. I'll post results of remap within 30m and open a PR with failing examples if repro holds.
